item.title: African Pride sales head David Holland to retire after 40 years+
item.description: David began his career as a travel agent before joining Qantas Jetabout in 1987, moving to Travel 2 in 1990, where he spent 16 years as Sales Director, before moving to Gold Medal. He joined African Pride in 2011 and became a co-owner in 2017.

item.description: New routes taking off from Newcastle include Antalya, Malta, Tenerife and Sharm-El-Sheikh

item.description: A now-deleted post advertising a livestream about joining Katie Price Travels caused outrage earlier this month, but InteleTravel tells TTG Price has not joined the agency's ranks

item.title: Cruise.co.uk and Ambassador team up for country music voyage
item.description: Departing from Tilbury, Essex, on March 25, 2027, the four-night cruise will host a number of themed events onboard the 1,400-guest Ambience. Country music quizzes, dining, silent discos and fitness sessions will feature, alongside line dancing classes and open mic sessions for aspiring singer-songwriters. Tribute acts to Johnny Cash, Shania Twain, Lainey Wilson and Luke Combs will perform, alongside bands including The Charmed and Britt &amp; The Backbeat.

item.title: Virgin Voyages unveils winter 2027/28 programme
item.description: Brilliant Lady will operate voyages from Los Angeles calling at destinations in the Mexican Riviera, Pacific Coast and Panama Canal before transitioning into a Caribbean winter season, sailing from Miami. In addition, the ship will sail a series of seven-night Mexican Riviera cruises, as well as a 17-night Panama Canal sailing from Los Angeles to Miami with visits to Cabo San Lucas, Puntarenas, Cartagena and Puerto Quetzal.

item.title: Tui Care Foundation creates academy for out of work youngsters
item.description: With UK unemployment and NEET (Not in Education, Employment or Training) levels highlighting growing need for inclusive routes into work, apprenticeships offer a proven solution for young people seeking long-term careers.Yet despite the availability of Apprenticeship Levy funding for training, many SMEs continue to struggle to take on apprentices due to wage pressure and wider economic challenges.

item.title: Viking's incoming hydrogen ship touches water for first time
item.description: It marked a major construction milestone and the first time the 998-passenger ship touched water.Scheduled for delivery in November 2026, the Viking Libra will spend her inaugural season sailing itineraries in the Mediterranean and Northern Europe.“The float out of the Viking Libra represents another milestone for Viking and our continued partnership with Fincantieri,” said Torstein Hagen, Viking chair and chief executive.
